lines.t: I spent twelve years in school and they taught me how to find the area of a triangle but they spent zero minutes teaching me how to do my taxes.
And twelve years is about as long as a dog lives so a whole dog lived and died while I was learning triangles.
So I did the only reasonable thing and I went back to school.
For the next thirty days I am sitting in every single class a normal school has because I am looking for the one lesson that teaches you about money.
If I find it I win but if I don't find it I am writing that class myself and you are all taking it.
So on day one I walked into my math class.
